The Champions · Nashville · October 28–31, 2026

Four Days of Entertainment
You Can't Miss

From Opening Ceremonies to WBE Concert 250 Reel America featuring Riley Green and special guest Randy Houser in downtown Nashville, live entertainment fills every day at The Champions.

Buy VIP packages & Concert Passes
Performers 
Live Entertainment

Riley Green Live at The Pinnacle

CMA and ACM Award winner Riley Green is bringing his show to The Pinnacle in Nashville on Friday, October 30. Presented by World Bass Enterprises as part of WBE Concert 250, it's a night of live country music you won't want to miss. VIP packages are on sale now, with individual tickets coming soon.

Hosted at Nashville's award-winning Pinnacle on the eve of the crowning of the World Champion Angler

WBE Concert 250 will bring together anglers, fans, partners and guests for an unforgettable evening of live music celebrating the outdoor traditions, shared experiences and American pastimes that continue to connect generations of families across the country.
